title: bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1: Pollard rho in GT on Frobenius classes

claims.statement: For uniform nonidentity Q in G2 and uniform z in GT (BLS12-381 fixed-argument pairing inversion into G1, C = 20,000), compute g = e(P0, Q) with one reduced pairing, find x = log_g z by parallel Pollard rho with distinguished points on classes under the order-12 Frobenius action z -> z^p (class size 12, N' = (r-1)/12 + 1), and output P = [x]P0. A fixed budget of T = 1.05 k + 2^104 productive walk steps, k = sqrt(0.98859 N'), halts with success probability at least 0.39: the birthday bound 1 - exp(-T^2/(2 N_eff)) with N_eff = N' (1 + 1/16) (1 + 2^-15), which folds in the additive-walk penalty sqrt(1 + 1/16) = 1.0308 and the cycle waste, gives 0.401. Total work is at most 2^126.19 dense Fp12 multiplication equivalents, including the pairing, jump table, 1.40 units per step (one dense multiplication plus 8,000 charged instructions of key computation), distinguished-point handling at rate 2^-80, walk starts, cycle handling (detection at a fixed period of 64 steps, then an escape by squaring the state at the least-key member of the cycle, at most 192 steps per event at about 2^-23.5845 events per step, charged as a factor 1 + 2^-15), scalar multiplication and verification. Peak memory is at most 2^53.7 bytes (records 2^52.28 plus tables 2^52.91); preprocessing is at most 2^50 units and is included in the total; nonuniform advice is 2^0 bytes. The attack is classical and relies on the stated heuristics: random-mapping behaviour of the class walk with s = 2^20 branches, and independence of the walk's jump and conjugation choices on distinct classes, which the fruitless-cycle count uses.

experiments.purpose: Toy-scale check of the class walk with conjugated jump tables, the period-64 cycle detection and the squaring escape at the least-key member: recovery, merge of trails started at one class with different phases, escapes that fall back into their cycle (squaring against the earlier table-step escape as a control), and the distinct classes visited until two trails first collide, against an ideal random mapping run through the same procedure. This does not establish production costs.
